note: Phase 1 cast: 4 authored characters. Female entries carry hijab:true - the passenger/character builder MUST use person_hijab mesh and hijab material for them (ART_BIBLE §5, geometry-level enforcement). Colours are albedo tints (hex).

cast.line_en: The workshop closes in ten minutes, ya ostaz!
cast.line_ar: الورش هتقفل بعد عشر دقايق يا أستاذ!

cast.line_en: My exam is at nine sharp - please, the fast way!
cast.line_ar: الامتحان الساعة تسعة بالظبط - لو سمحت من الطريق السريع!

cast.line_en: These crates are full of tomatoes - gently, gently!
cast.line_ar: الصناديق دي كلها طماطم - على مهلك يا عم!

cast.line_en: The koshary is waiting and so is my boss.
